newsitem.title: USA: Unicom's ComEd to retire Zion plant early.
newsitem.headline: Unicom's ComEd to retire Zion plant early.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co, a unit of Unicom Corp, said Thursday it would retire its Zion nuclear power plant early, probably within eight years, and would not spend $400 million needed to replace its steam generators.
The Zion facility will be retired much earlier than its licensed life in 2013 and most likely before 2005, ComEd said.
Utility officials said the decision was part of an ongoing assessment of the economic viability of its power generating assets, including its nuclear power facilities.

Zion began commercial operations in 1973. One of its two units has been out of service since late February but is scheduled to return to service later this year, ComEd said. The other unit has been shut down since September.
Shares of Unicom, a utility holding company, closed up 1/8 Thursday at 19-1/8.
